QuestInfo.name: [Ellin Forest] The Reason for the Artificial Rain
QuestInfo.0:
Why is Yuris repairing the airship in the rain?
Go ask #bYuris#k.
QuestInfo.1:
Yuris said the rain in the forest is artificial, but Perzen is looking for you.
Go see #bPerzen#k in #bAltaire Camp#k.
QuestInfo.2:
Yuris said the rain in the forest is artificial.
Dust formed when the continent divided from the Black Mage's invasion. Perzen used magic to create rain and make it settle.

default.0: Hurry over to #bPerzen#k. It seemed urgent.
